sections.heading: Todoist limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool; Team features mainly on Business; Reporting is personal productivity, not PMO because it forces process changes or add-ons around Todoist when task boards is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Beginner until task boards is mandatory; plan jumps to Pro only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain task boards at the expense of Seat minimums and AI credit bundles vs published per-seat floors — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Beginner · free · task boards | Pro | Business.

Alternative context: unlike Asana, Todoist is preferable when Personal productivity and to-do capture because task boards plus task boards match; prefer Asana when Work OS / portfolio buyers because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Todoist
sections.body:
Use-case: for Personal productivity and to-do capture running task boards, prefer Todoist when task boards is weekly; pick another path when Work OS / portfolio buyers.

Setup requires a specialist owner when Not a Work OS or portfolio tool collides with task boards; SMB pilots can stay lighter if task boards is already on Pro.

Integrations in research: Slack, Google Calendar, Microsoft Teams.

Wrap: choose Todoist only if the implementation job is task boards under Personal productivity and to-do capture; otherwise use Finder constraints instead of copying this page for another vendor.
